title: Key Points on Regenerative Medicine for Daily Routine Practice
content: The principles of regeneration are found in different types of cultures, from long time ago. As an interdisciplinary field of research, regenerative medicine,  play a great role in tissues and organs damaged reparation with a higher potential in transplantation if necessary.  The definition of stem cells can be extended. From this point of view, we can mention taking in consideration the idea in which it is known that these cells form the base of the building body.
